audit.commission: David: 'i dont think i see all the logs being logged.' He was right — three gaps, all fixed the same night.
audit.gap_a: PLAIN lane: 2 calls (07:00Z, 19:45Z) marked SETTLE MISSING and never retried — the grader skipped any window carrying a grade key. FIXED: missing-marked windows retry via a direct Gamma read; both windows late-graded (both were RIGHT) and stamped LATE REGRADE with their source.
audit.gap_b: Race rails: 12 Polymarket positions stuck open for hours — the settle loop read a live-book function that returns None for resolved markets, and failed silently. FIXED: dedicated Gamma settlement read; all 12 settled and sealed within one run (TAPE took 10 wins of 11).
audit.gap_c: The REAL watch sealed nothing — real-money instructions lived only in cron output. FIXED: every REAL CALL/EXIT now seals a BTC5R_SIGNAL/BTC5ER_SIGNAL record, failure-proof so a seal error can never block a relay.
audit.clean: EARLY and RIPTIDE audited clean: every call, value, flip, seed, play and grade is sealed.
